description: The 2022 Kia Sorento SX is a sophisticated and capable SUV that offers an exceptional driving experience. With its turbocharged engine, advanced technology, and premium amenities, this Sorento is the perfect choice for the discerning buyer seeking a vehicle that blends style, performance, and practicality.  Boasting a striking black exterior, the Sorento SX commands attention on the road. Its sleek and modern design is complemented by a host of premium features, including:  - Carpeted Floor Mats - Cargo Net  This Sorento SX is equipped with a powerful 2.5L I4 DGI Turbocharged DOHC 16V engine that delivers an impressive 281 horsepower, ensuring a thrilling and responsive driving experience. Paired with an 8-Speed DCT transmission and front-wheel drive, this SUV offers exceptional efficiency, with an EPA-estimated 22 mpg in the city and 29 mpg on the highway.  Step inside the Sorento SX and you'll be greeted by a spacious and well-appointed cabin that caters to your every need. Enjoy the comfort of heated front seats, the convenience of a power liftgate, and the peace of mind provided by advanced safety features like Blind Spot Monitoring, Rear Cross-Traffic Alert, and a Surround View Monitor.  The Sorento SX also boasts a wealth of advanced technology, including a state-of-the-art infotainment system with a large touchscreen display, seamless smartphone integration via Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, and a premium audio system that will elevate your listening experience.
